visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short dark hair and glasses wearing a white long-sleeved shirt stands against a background of a bookshelf and a lamp in a studio setting. He gestures with both hands, moving them in a chopping and open-palm motion as his mouth moves continuously. Large yellow and white text overlays appear at the top. (2) The scene cuts to a scenic landscape of lush green terraced fields under a bright, hazy sky with mountains in the background. A small yellow bus icon with text appears in the center. (3) The man returns to the screen, gesturing emphatically with one hand raised. A white document with Chinese text titled '公路公共運輸發展計畫' scrolls over the background. (4) Footage shows an orange and white public bus parked on a street with several elderly people waiting to board. The lighting is natural daylight. (5) A different white and red bus drives through a city intersection. This is followed by a short animation of a claymation-style sheep giving a thumbs-up against a blurred bus interior background. (6) A surprised cat meme appears briefly, followed by a stylized animation of a bus driving on a winding black road between purple mountains and a red sky. (7) A drone shot shows a long, straight road lined with green trees from a top-down perspective. A small vehicle moves along the road. (8) A group of people board a green bus at a busy roadside stop. This transitions to an animation of a character walking towards a red bus at a stop sign. (9) A clip of a man in an office yelling 'NO' with a shocked expression is shown. (10) Scenic photos of rural winding roads with trees and blooming white flowers (cherry blossoms) appear, with text labels identifying the location as Taitung. (11) An animation shows a bear clinging to a red downward-pointing arrow. Then, a yellow school bus is seen flying or jumping through the air in a cartoonish style. (12) A drone shot follows a white bus driving along a coastal road next to green cliffs and the ocean. The footage turns black and white as it fades. (13) The man returns to the studio, pointing towards the camera and then downwards. A research paper titled 'What are More Efficient Transportation Services...' is displayed. (14) A coordinate graph appears with icons representing a bus, a taxi, and a 'DRTS' bubble, showing relationship between service volume and price. (15) Photographs of white vans with '幸福巴士' and '幸福小黃' branding are shown, with drivers and local residents, including children, smiling and giving thumbs-up. (16) A final animation shows a bus icon transforming into icons of a person, money, and a group of people. The man in the white shirt continues his explanation and points towards the bottom of the frame.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A clear, energetic male voice begins speaking in Mandarin with professional enunciation. An upbeat, rhythmic electronic BGM starts simultaneously, featuring a steady synth beat and bright melodic tones. A sharp 'Whoosh' SFX accompanies the first visual title change. (2) As the topic shifts to rural transport, a 'Ding' SFX highlights new text. The speaker's pitch variability increases to emphasize keywords like 'Not that simple.' (3) A comic 'pop' sound effect occurs as an animation appears. The BGM remains consistent in tempo (approx. 128 BPM) but ducks slightly under the voice. (4) A loud vocal clip of a man yelling 'NO' (from The Office) cuts through the narration briefly, followed by a 'Whoosh' transition back to the main narrator. (5) As technical terms like 'DRTS' are introduced, a series of 'Blip' sound effects coincide with graphical icons appearing on the chart. (6) The vocal delivery remains high-arousal and authoritative through the conclusion. A final triumphant melodic stinger concludes the audio track as the BGM fades out with a quick 'Whoosh'.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To educate viewers on the limitations of traditional public bus systems in rural areas (scale, space, and time mismatches) and introduce 'Demand Responsive Transport Services' (DRTS) as a more efficient, flexible solution currently being implemented in Taiwan.
